purpose: Single source of truth for cargo parallelism and build environment variables. These values are data, not code decisions: every production site is a reader that forwards them, so the value must be declared exactly once here and verified everywhere else. Before this file existed the value 1 appeared in seven places with no authority, and .cargo/config.toml could not govern it because an environment variable overrides that file.
precedence_rule: When a site passes a variable through the environment, the environment wins over .cargo/config.toml. Therefore .cargo/config.toml can only govern invocations that set nothing, and it is deliberately not the authority for parallelism.

canonical_gate.note: Both force the environment explicitly, so both read the values below and ignore .cargo/config.toml.

parallelism.declared_reason: No measurement of the canonical gate justifies this value. It predates the current work and its origin is not recorded in the repository.

measured_alternative.measured_on: cynic-builder CT105, manual cargo build, rustc 1.95.0 as pinned by rust-toolchain.toml
measured_alternative.two_job_results: rc=0 on all four, zero compiler errors, zero internal compiler errors
measured_alternative.scope_warning: These figures apply to a manually launched cargo build. They do not yet apply to make check or cynic build proof, because those force CARGO_BUILD_JOBS from the environment. Adopting 2 here requires proving it on the canonical path first.

not_measured: cargo_build_jobs 3 and 4: the optimum above 2 is unknown
any value on the canonical gate itself: no canonical-path measurement exists
whether the original single job default answered a constraint other than the rustc ICE recorded in .cargo/config.toml
parallelism.revert_instruction: If an internal compiler error appears on any commit, set cargo_build_jobs back to 1 here, propagate, and record the commit that broke it. The ICE risk cited in .cargo/config.toml is real and is not dismissed by the measurements above.

cargo_config_toml_scope.applies_to: manual cargo invocations that set no environment, for example a developer running cargo test directly
does_not_apply_to: any adapter that passes CARGO_BUILD_JOBS through the environment
cargo_config_toml_scope.why_the_divergence_is_legitimate: the two paths are genuinely different surfaces. The canonical gate always sets the variable explicitly, so the registry governs it. A direct cargo invocation inherits the config file instead. Declaring the value here, with its scope, keeps the difference deliberate rather than accidental.
cargo_config_toml_scope.why_it_would_be_wrong_without_this_recor: an undeclared divergence between a registry and a config file is indistinguishable from drift, and the next reader cannot tell which number is authoritative for their invocation
cargo_config_toml_scope.evidence: four commits, 641 s single job against 247 to 282 s at two jobs, zero compiler errors

rust_min_stack.declared_reason: Present at three production sites with no recorded justification. Held here so the value has one location.

cargo_incremental.declared_reason: Stale incremental cache produces ghost errors under rustc 1.96 per .cargo/config.toml. Held here for the same reason.

cargo_target_dir_shared.declared_reason: Shared build target directory used by the remote runner.

coherence_contract.rule: Every consumer site must carry the value declared in parallelism.cargo_build_jobs. The test fails when a site diverges, and also fails when a consumer is added without being declared here.
coherence_contract.replaces: crates/cynic-cli/tests/architecture_boundary.rs previously asserted the literal string CYNIC_CARGO_BUILD_JOBS ?= 1, which made the value itself the contract and would have failed on any legitimate policy change.
coherence_contract.why_in_src_not_tests: the canonical proof runner passes --lib, so a test under tests/ is never executed by it. The module lives in src/ so the gate actually runs it.

toolchain_drift.observation: Three toolchain versions coexist. rust-toolchain.toml pins 1.95.0 and overrides the builder, whose system rustc is 1.93.0. Pre-existing comments in .cargo/config.toml cite 1.96, a version no checkout runs.
toolchain_drift.consequence: The rustc ICE rationale behind jobs = 1 was recorded against a toolchain that is not the one in use, so it cannot be assumed to still hold.
